findings.closure_conditions: Ensure trailers are placed in a contiguous terminal block (separated from the commit message body by a blank line, with no empty lines between trailers) so that `git interpret-trailers --parse` / `agent-bus prepare-merge` parses `Agent-Bus-Agent: c-stdlib`.
findings.rationale: Commit dfdd67fb5620a0d627b3ea596ea41722ac7ccf8c has an intervening blank line between 'Agent-Bus-Agent: c-stdlib' and 'Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>'. Under git trailer conventions (and `git interpret-trailers --parse`), trailers must be in a single contiguous block at the end of the commit message. The blank line causes git to treat 'Agent-Bus-Agent' as commit body text rather than a trailer, leading `agent-bus prepare-merge` to fail with 'error: commit dfdd67fb5620a0d627b3ea596ea41722ac7ccf8c has no Agent-Bus-Agent trailer' under AGENT_REVIEW.md §1.2/§2.

data.expected: Normative guidelines in docs/AGENT_REVIEW.md codifying formal verification review standards for Lean 4 artifacts.
data.observed_behavior: Current review guidelines specify workflow and gate mechanics, but lack normative design standards for evaluating Lean proof methods, universal quantification vs point checks, theorem selection, and proof conciseness.
reproduction: Reviewers currently evaluate Lean nominations without normative guidelines distinguishing universal domain proofs from concrete spot fixtures.

Propose standardizing five normative review criteria in docs/AGENT_REVIEW.md: (1) Proof methods & strength audit (induction principles, propositional extensionality, constructive decidability, zero sorry/axiomatic allowlist compliance); (2) Universal quantification (forall) over point checks (ensuring spot checks/eval fixtures are not treated as domain proof coverage); (3) Explicit structured review reports stating why theorems proven are good and why they are insufficient; (4) Proof conciseness and generality (factoring small, general proofs over sprawling case splits); (5) Monotonic improvement bar with tracked follow-up items for non-blocking gaps.
data.summary: Establish normative Lean review standards: proof methods, universal quantification vs point checks, theorem adequacy, and conciseness
